info.name: QuarantinePay — agent contracts, quarantine, capture/void
info.description:
Run against a local server in QP_MODE=replay (simulated payments) with the Collection Runner or newman: `npx newman run docs/QuarantinePay.postman_collection.json --env-var admin_token=<QP_ADMIN_PASSWORD> --timeout-request 30000`.

Folders A–D each run one agent task end to end: A injected delivery → 409 on approve without acknowledgement → reject → void; B compliant → approve → capture; C injected → approve with acknowledge_risk (audited override); D incomplete → automatic void. Poll requests repeat themselves (setNextRequest) up to max_polls times.

Sandbox mode: the run stops at step 5 and logs the PayPal approval_url. Approve as the Sandbox buyer, then continue from step 6. Only provider-returned results count as confirmed. Sellers and deliveries are fictional; a hold is not escrow.
